_about: Module manifests for every SynTHBloK plugin (name, description, tags). tools/make_plugins.py copies them into each plugin.json.

Quad.name: QUAD
Quad.description: Quad-oscillator synth voice with filter, envelope, glide, accent and LFO

MtxQuad.name: MTX Quad
MtxQuad.description: The quad-oscillator synth voice played by an 8x8 note grid with per-step accent, cutoff, gate, glide, chance, ratchet, octave and resonance sliders

DualFilter.name: Dual Filter
DualFilter.description: Two stereo multimode filters (LP / BP / notch / HP sweep, 12 / 24 / 48 dB) with drive, run in series, parallel or stereo, linked cutoffs, a four-shape LFO, an ADSR or envelope follower, a stereo phaser and a three-band EQ

Stereo.name: Stereo Phaser
Stereo.description: Stereo width, tilt, air, glue, punch and clip, with analyzer

FX.name: Character Delay
FX.description: Stereo delay with eight characters (clean, tape, analog, modern, ping-pong, dynamic, space, reverse), clock sync, hold and clear

Resonator.name: Resonator
Resonator.description: Stereo modal resonator with metal, wood, membrane and tube bodies

Mix24.name: MIX-6 Fire Edition
Mix24.description: Six-channel stereo mixer with per-channel tilt, drive, air and glue, mute/solo, meters and an aux FX bus

Mix12.name: MIX-12 Fire Edition
Mix12.description: Twelve-channel stereo mixer with per-channel tilt, drive, air and glue, mute/solo, meters and an aux FX bus

Mix8.name: MIX-8 Fire Edition
Mix8.description: Eight-channel stereo mixer with per-channel tilt, drive, air and glue, mute/solo, meters and an aux FX bus

NoizeeFlagshipFilter.name: Morph Filter
NoizeeFlagshipFilter.description: Stereo drive into a state-variable filter that morphs LP to BP to HP, with audio-rate FM, 1V/oct keytrack, random chaos drift and cutoff spread

BlokMaster.name: BloKMaster
BlokMaster.description: Mastering strip: trim, tilt EQ, shelves, glue compressor, punch, limiter, stereo tools, air and output gain

Player.name: Player Plus
Player.description: MIDI file player with a watch folder: 16 poly tracks (pitch, gate, velocity), 16th-note clock, reset and end outputs, speed and transpose

Kick.name: Kick
Kick.description: Hard techno kick: pitch-swept sine, click, drive, tone, schranz rumble tail with ducking, accent and envelope out

PlayerView.name: MIDI + Expansion
PlayerView.description: MIDI display for Player Plus: scrolling piano roll of the loaded MIDI with playhead, track activity and transport readout

SnareHat.name: Snare/Hat
SnareHat.description: Techno snare and hi-hat voice: two-oscillator snare body with noise snap, six-oscillator metallic hats with closed/open triggers and choke, drive, tone and accent

Euclid.name: Euclid
Euclid.description: Four-channel Euclidean rhythm generator: steps, hits and rotate per channel, clock/reset/run inputs, 10 ms trigger outputs for drums and gates

JamProbe.name: JAM Probe
JamProbe.description: MIDI monitor and test transmitter for mapping controllers such as the Maschine JAM: live message log, per-control statistics, test notes/CCs, auto sweep, copy/save map summary

Jam.name: JAM
Jam.description: Maschine JAM controller: 8x8 pad trigger sequencer with 8 patterns, plus the 8 touch strips as CV outputs with 8 banks; JAM lights follow the module

Matrix8.name: MTX-8
Matrix8.description: Maschine JAM groovebox: 8x8 step sequencer driving 8 built-in synth voices (morphing oscillator, resonant filter, envelopes, drive, pan), touch strips shape each voice, stereo out

GrainForge.name: GRAIN-FORGE
GrainForge.description: Beat shuffler, glitch, robot vocoder, clock-locked gate/filter and a warp delay whose repeats loop back through the robot and pulse stages; clock-locked stereo FX chain

MatrixForge.name: MTX FORGE
MatrixForge.description: Maschine JAM groovebox: the MTX-8 sequencer and 8 voices, and the whole mix (plus IN L/R) through the GRAIN-FORGE FX chain, clocked by the sequencer

Duo.name: MTX-DUO
Duo.description: LEAD and BASS dual-oscillator mono synths (wave morph, hard sync, FM, sub, 24 dB filter, ADSR, drive, glide) with their own 8-step note sequencer in a key and scale, 8 patterns, clock/reset/run in, audio, pitch and gate out

Drum.name: MTX-DRUM
Drum.description: Drum-synth groovebox: 8 voices (kick, snare, clap, tom, hat, metal, FM, noise models) on the MTX 8x8 sequencer with accents, 8 patterns, strip banks, choke groups, per-voice audio and trigger outs, final filter, delay, reverb and FORGE FX, Maschine JAM control

Echo.name: MTX-ECHO
Echo.description: Stereo delay and looper: 12 delay types (MTX ping-pong, clean digital, chorused, analog, tape, lo-fi, ducking, reverse, ping-pong, slap, octave shimmer, multi-head space echo), tap tempo and clock with 11 subdivisions incl. dual, freeze, kill dry, trails, reverb, 6 presets, 60 s stereo looper with overdub, play once and undo

Loop.name: MTX-LOOP
Loop.description: 8-track loop sampler built on the MTX-ECHO looper: record / replace, play / stop, play once, undo / redo and clear per track, tempo-locked lengths with count-in, clock or tempo knob, mono or stereo (poly) tracks, 8 inputs with gain and monitor, 8 outputs and a stereo mix, scenes, a JAM-style grid and an OLED showing all 8 loops

MatrixFx.name: MTX-FX
MatrixFx.description: 8-input effects matrix played from the MTX 8x8 grid and the Maschine JAM: 8 effect slots (64 effects in 7 tabs: drive, filter, mod, glitch, delay, reverb, dynamics), 12 one-click chains, accents, 8 routing scenes, slot links and dub chains, drag-and-drop OLED setup, musical RAND, DJ filter, 60 s tempo-locked looper (MTX-ECHO's)

MatrixSong.name: MTX Composer
MatrixSong.description: Song arranger for the MTX modules: finds MTX-8, FORGE, DUO, DRUM, FX, ECHO and LOOP in the patch by itself (no cables), 8 sections A-H that set each module's pattern, mute, level and loop action, launches on the bar or beat, cycles through 1-8 sections every 1-16 bars, master clock (CLOCK, BAR, SECT) and Maschine JAM control

Randroyd.name: RANDROYD
Randroyd.description: Track generator: builds a rack of MTX modules and a mixer, writes genre-based songs into it with an arrangement, ROLL / MUTATE / GROW, and 8 save banks of 8 tracks

Backdrop.name: BACKDROP
Backdrop.description: Dresses the whole rack: a background (colour, SynTHBloK looks or your image), a case around the modules from a library of case styles, and the patch title

Blank.name: BLANK
Blank.description: A NoiZee ToyZ blank panel for empty rack space: badge, backlit or circuit look, 1 to 32 HP
